meaning:
1) to thrust, oppress, crowd
1a) (Qal) to thrust, crowd

elsewhere.note: When Yahweh raised up judges for them, then Yahweh was with the judge, and saved them out of the hand of their enemies all the days of the judge; for it…
Neither does one jostle another; they march everyone in his path, and they burst through the defenses, and don’t break ranks.
